correctness.rationale: The beta/gamma absolute-moment identity, conditional residual-ball expectation, and exact orthogonal decomposition of the full quadratic polynomial space yield the claimed blocks in every dimension >=3. Explicit two-by-two Gram normalization gives the gamma coefficient. The computed multiplicities sum to the full dimension; full-monomial generalized eigenproblems agree in d=3,...,12, and independent disk quadrature agrees in d=4. No finite run is treated as the proof.

value.rationale: The two-plane quarter-ball is a canonical incomplete-volume region for degree-two polynomial and Zernike-type inverse models. The theorem classifies the complete all-dimensional concentration spectrum, reduces a space of quadratic dimension to explicit size-at-most-four blocks, identifies a protected large quarter-energy subspace, and yields sharp best/worst energy fractions; these are motivated natural spectral invariants rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. The statement is restricted to the proved degree-two geometry.
